question: At what request count and over what window does the keyless Visual Crossing Timeline API answer HTTP 429 to one client IP?
why: No fixed allowance is published. On 2026-11-02 about 4,000 keyless Timeline calls from one address in about 30 minutes, up to 90 in parallel and about 1,000 of them 48-record queries, all answered HTTP 200, so no threshold was reached. A longer window, or a client address of another kind, may be needed.
